title: 3x faster git checkouts with StarSling Disks
summary: Add git-mirror: true to starslingdev/disks for 3x faster git checkouts in GitHub Actions. Keep actions/checkout and download only what changed.
body_markdown:
Starting today,[StarSling Disks](https://starsling.dev/blog/disks) speed up checkouts with the new[git-mirror](https://docs.starsling.dev/runners/disks#faster-checkout-git-mirror) input. StarSling keeps a snapshot of a recent default-branch commit, so set it to true in a job, and that job's git checkout on[StarSling Runners](https://starsling.dev/products/runners) runs up to 3x faster.


Every GitHub Actions job checks out the repository before its first real step, and` actions/checkout` downloads the full tree of the commit each time. On a large repository that download often takes 10 seconds or more, on every job. Earlier this month we launched[StarSling Disks](https://starsling.dev/blog/disks) , persistent filesystems mounted into StarSling Runners.` git-mirror` puts the checkout on a Disk too.


Your workflow keeps its` actions/checkout` step. Before the first step runs, StarSling copies a recent commit of your default branch from a Disk named` git` into the job's workspace, so` actions/checkout` downloads only what changed since that commit.


## 3x faster checkouts


Checkout Mastra jobs Checkout size Checkout ready


GitHub` actions/checkout` 10 25,308 files, 64.6 MiB 10.4 s


StarSling` git-mirror` 10 25,308 files, 64.6 MiB 3.5 s


**StarSling speedup** Same commit **3.0x**


Checkout ready is the time from the start of the checkout until the workspace holds the commit under test, including the 0.41 s copy from the` git` disk. All times are medians on a StarSling 4 vCPU runner, with every job checking out the same Mastra commit and the stored copy 12 hours older than that commit.


[Mastra](https://starsling.dev/customers/mastra) turned on` git-mirror` for 24 of its CI jobs by merging[one pull request](https://github.com/mastra-ai/mastra/pull/31213) , opened by a StarSling agent. The pull request has the full A/B: every job with` git-mirror` finished its checkout faster than the fastest standard checkout.


## How` git-mirror` works


The` git` disk holds one commit of your default branch, without its history.


- **Seed.** The runner reads` git-mirror: true` from the workflow before any step starts, and copies the stored commit into the job's empty workspace.
- **Check out.** Your` actions/checkout` step runs first, as it does today. The workspace already holds a recent commit of your default branch, so the step downloads only what changed between that commit and the commit under test.
- **Refresh.** The first successful default-branch job (push, schedule, or manual run) with` git-mirror: true` creates the copy. After that, such a job rebuilds it when its commit is 12 hours or more newer than the stored one.
- **Self-contained.** The copy lands in the workspace's own` .git` folder, so a Docker step that mounts the workspace sees a complete repository.


## What changes in a job


` git-mirror` is set in the workflow file and runs on the same Disks as your dependency stores and build output.


Standard` actions/checkout` With` git-mirror`


Checkout action` actions/checkout`` actions/checkout` (unchanged)


Download from GitHub The full tree of the commit, on every job What changed since the stored commit


Configuration Workflow YAML` git-mirror: true` in workflow YAML


Storage Ephemeral runner disk StarSling Disk (` git` ), managed with` sling disks`


Workspace layout Self-contained working tree Self-contained working tree


Like every Disk, the` git` disk encrypts file contents and filenames at rest, with a unique key for each storage layer. Default-branch jobs update it, pull requests and other branches read it, and forks and Dependabot runs stay isolated from it.


## Add` git-mirror` to a workflow


Run the job on a StarSling Runners label, grant` id-token: write` , keep` actions/checkout` as the first step, and pass` git-mirror: true` to` starslingdev/disks@v0` :


```text
jobs  :
test  :
runs-on  :   starsling-ubuntu-26.04
permissions  :
contents  :   read
id-token  :   write
steps  :
-   uses  :   actions/checkout@v4


-   uses  :   starslingdev/disks@v0
with  :
git-mirror  :   true


-   run  :   pnpm test
```


When you add the step:


- **Use a literal flag on an unconditional step.** The runner reads the workflow before any step runs, so write` git-mirror: true` as a literal value on a step with no` if:` .
- **Start with a plain checkout.** The copy seeds jobs whose steps run directly on the runner and whose first step is` actions/checkout` of this repository, with no` if:` or` path` , and a` fetch-depth` of 1 or more. The default depth is 1.
- **Grant OIDC.** Each job with` git-mirror: true` needs` id-token: write` , so StarSling can verify the job through GitHub OIDC.
- **Combine it with other Disks.**` git-mirror: true` can stand on its own step or share a job with other Disks steps, such as` preset: pnpm-store` or` preset: cargo-target` .
- **Manage it with` sling disks` .** See the` git` disk with` sling disks list` . To turn it off, remove the flag from your workflows, then run` sling disks delete git --repo <owner/name>` . The[sling disks reference](https://docs.starsling.dev/sling-cli/commands/disks) and the[Disks docs](https://docs.starsling.dev/runners/disks#faster-checkout-git-mirror) have the details.


The action is open source at[starslingdev/disks](https://github.com/starslingdev/disks) .


## Pricing


The` git` disk counts toward your[StarSling Disks storage](https://docs.starsling.dev/pricing#disks) at **$0.50 per GB-month** , measured daily, with no per-job attach fee. It holds one compressed commit, with no history.


## Enable` git-mirror` today


` git-mirror` is available to every organization on StarSling Runners with billing set up.[Sign up with GitHub](https://runners.starsling.dev/login) and add` git-mirror: true` to your workflows. Once a default-branch job with the flag succeeds, later jobs with the flag start from the copy.
